rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Shrub.
Exhibition name: Garden and Home
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, 2001).
Introduced in United States by Heirloom Roses, Inc. (USA) in 2011 as 'Moonlight in Paris'.
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 2018 as 'Moonlight in Paris'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot, gold center, ages to light pink . Moderate, fruity, spice fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped, old-fashioned bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium. Dark green foliage.

Height: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm). Width: 3' to 4' (90 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
This rose commemorates the 50th Anniversary of the popular South African gardening magazine Garden and Home...

Source: Moonlight in Paris

colour: Apricot, gold center, ages to light pink .
